    @pytest.mark.priority(4)
    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for validating user weight loss graph when weight loss is observed by 45%. For example when starting weight is 273, target weight is 110 and current weight is 150.")
    def test_validateUserWeightLossGraph_7Percent(self):
        login_credentials = config.get_login_credentials()
        headers, _ = createSession(self.base_url, login_credentials['usernameAdmin'], login_credentials['passwordAdmin'])
        self.__class__.userId = fetchUserId(self.base_url, headers, self.__class__.userCohort, self.__class__.testUserForApiQuery)
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/coaches/v1/users/{self.__class__.userId}/weights"
        request_payload = load_request_payload("addWeight.json")
        request_payload["weight"] = 150
        request_payload["date"] = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers,data=json.dumps(request_payload))
        assert response.status_code == 200
        startingwtvalue,self.__class__.targetwtvalue, currentwtvalue, weightLossPercent = self.checkWeightLossGraph_on_userPortal()
        if currentwtvalue!=startingwtvalue:
            wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)
            wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, self.blueProgressSegment)))
            weightLossValueFromChart = self.driver.find_element(By.XPATH, self.weightGraphValueText)
